Emma (AE): Heads-up — AcmeMedical wants a 6mo POC that includes API + Optimize + Console add-on. They're asking for a 30% discount across the board and dedicated support. Need quick deal-desk guidance before I push the proposal.
Ravi (SE): What's the expected usage profile for the POC? latency/SLOs? dedicated GPU pools?
Emma (AE): POC goals: pilot document summarization + reranking. Expected tokens ~3M total over 6 months, spikes during ingest. They want canary on dedicated for predictable latency and the Console for metrics + Optimize for batching suggestions.
Carlos (Solutions): If they need Dedicated, that changes economics. We could offer smaller discount plus credits for Dedicated hours + onboarding hours instead of blanket 30%. Credits keep list prices intact for renewals.
Jordan (SalesOps): FYI rate card constraints: for commercial POC we typically cap discounts at 20% without VP approval. For cross-product stacks (API+Optimize+Console) target: either 20% off list or equivalent credits + 3 months of Console Premium. Need ARR/commit justification to go higher.
Emma (AE): They aren't ready for a full commit, it's purely evaluation — likely convert if performance/lower unit cost met. Typical ARR? hard to say; conservative estimate $120k ARR if they convert in 12 months.
Priya (Legal): Any special T&Cs requested? Do we need to modify data handling? Also need SSO and security questionnaire status before Dedicated.
Emma (AE): Security questionnaire sent; waiting on their responses. No special legal terms requested yet beyond standard redlines.
Ravi (SE): Tech ask: we should propose a POC configuration. My recommendation: hosted API for gen, Optimize enabled with auto-batching, Console with full access for 6 months, optionally 1 Dedicated GPU for canary windows (8h/day) for 2 weeks. That keeps costs predictable.
Carlos (Solutions): Proposed pricing alternatives to present to the customer (quoted quickly):
```
Option A: 20% off list across API+Optimize+Console for 6 months. No Dedicated. + 40 hours onboarding (SE) included.
Option B: No list discount; $20k usage credits + 60 hours SE + Console Premium for 6 months. Dedicated canary included for 2 weeks.
Option C: 10% off + $10k credits + 20 hours SE. Dedicated add-on priced separately.
```
Jordan (SalesOps): Please include estimated cost to us (burndown) for Option B — Deal Desk needs to know expected unit margin impact. Also attach the conversion play (how we convert POC to commit).
DealDeskBot: Quick check — submit an approval request with supporting ARR justification and the recommended option. Thresholds: discounts >20% OR credits >$15k require VP-Sales signoff.
Emma (AE): Ok I'll prepare the approval packet. One question for Deal Desk: are credits treated as discount for approval thresholds or as promotional spend?
Jordan (SalesOps): Credits count as promotional spend and are reviewed similarly; >$15k escalates.
Priya (Legal): If we include Dedicated, hold final until their security questionnaire is reviewed and SSO contract terms confirmed.
Ravi (SE): I'll draft the POC runbook and estimate SE hours. EMMA — ping me once you have their questionnaire answers.
Emma (AE): Thanks all. I'll draft the packet with Option B as recommended by Solutions, include the ARR estimate and tech runbook, and submit to Deal Desk. pinging @DealDeskBot when ready :thumbsup:
DealDeskBot: Noted. Submit request here when ready and set the approval type to "POC bundle — promotional credits vs discount".
Emma (AE): Will do — ETA end of day. Thanks everyone.
